requirements.description: User prefers properties near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics). Value set to the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution, matching the 'near' proximity expression.

The user explicitly requires at least 360 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 18 people is not converted into an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied. Energy class and proximity to healthcare are outside the reference columns and are left to other agents. Turin is a geographic request handled by the Location Agent, so comune_code is not set.
User prefers energy class D or better, so all classes from A1 to D are accepted.

output.sql: SELECT * FROM ESTATES WHERE property_type = 'Uffici e assimilabili' AND surface_area >= 360 AND haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0 AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D') AND healthcare >= 75 ORDER BY haversine_km(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
output.explanation: Filters offices-type properties (property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili') with surface_area >= 360 m², within 3.0 km of the given coordinates (haversine on latitude/longitude), energy class A1–D, and healthcare proximity score >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from the coordinates, nearest first. The 18-occupant capacity and the non-quantified 'near healthcare' preference are not mapped to columns, since no matching filterable column or requirement was provided.
